title: Security & Privacy bridge fast source
description: Prefer the known threat JSON source before recursive discovery, restart the bridge and verify responsive bridge and GUI threat APIs.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent';$patch=Join-Path $root 'patch-security-monitor-bridge-fastsource-v1.py';Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3en4all/3en-command-runner/main/scripts/patch-security-monitor-bridge-fastsource-v1.py?ts='+[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()) -OutFile $patch -TimeoutSec 30;$py=(Get-Command python.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source;if(-not $py){$py=(Get-Command py.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source};& $py $patch;if($LASTEXITCODE-ne0){throw 'BRIDGE_FASTSOURCE_PATCH_FAILED'};Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*3en-security-monitor-bridge-v1.py*'}|ForEach-Object{Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue};Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN Security Monitor Bridge' -ErrorAction Stop;Start-Sleep -Seconds 3;Write-Host 'BRIDGE_FASTSOURCE_RESTART=PASS'
